<|channel|>analysis<|message|>We need to answer: "How does the MagicDrive encode the bounding box in training step?" Based on the passage: They describe the bounding box encoding in section 4.1: "Bounding Box Encoding: ... We maintain a separate encoder for bounding boxes. For bounding box (ci, bi) containing class label and box position bi, use method similar to Li et al (2023b) where pooled embeddings of class names are considered as label embeddings. For box positions bi (8 corners), use Fourier embedding to each point and pass through an MLP for encoding. Then use an MLP to compress both class and position embedding into one hidden vector: hb_i = Ebox(ci, bi) = MLPb(eb_c(i), eb_p(i))." So (4) eb_c(i) = AvgPool(Etext(Lci)) ; (5) hb_i = Ebox(ci, bi) = MLPb(eb_c(i), eb_p(i)). So the process: encouraging base labeling or recycling text embeddings. So answer is that they use the text encoder for the class label via average pooling; also treat box position as 8 tuple of points, Fourier embedding, pass through MLP, then combine => MLP compress. The options:

A: "MagicDrive encode the class labels of bounding box by the method similar to Li et al, where the pooled embeddings of the class names are considered as the label embeddings. And then uses an MLP to compress both the class and text embeddings into a single hidden vector for each bounding box." This matches using Etext(Lci) and then MLP. So A looks wrong because "class and text embeddings" but they refer to text embeddings? "class and text embeddings" it's ambiguous. D: "MagicDrive encode the class labels and the corner points separately, and then uses an MLP to compress them into a vector." That is correct. But albeit "class labels" and "corner points" do separate process: they embed class names via LLM text symbolic, then embed corners with Fourier and MLP. So D is basically same as described. Actually they embed class w label embeddings from text. It does not mention only "class embeddings" but "text embeddings" incorrectly? Ok maybe not.

Option B: "MagicDrive uses Fourier embedding for 4 corner point and passes them through an MLP for encoding in training step. MagicDrive then uses an MLP to compress both the class label and position embeddings into a single hidden vector for each bounding box." This says "Fourier embedding for 4 corner point" but actual has 8 corners. It says 4 corner point: The bounding box rectangular? So B is wrong because it's 8 corners.

Option C: "MagicDrive using the text encoder to encode the class label of bounding box, and then uses an MLP to compress both the class and text embeddings into a single hidden vector for each bounding box." This uses text encoder for class label but double "class and text embeddings" maybe confusing. In scheme, the text embeddings for class and text are separate. They embed class names into label embedding. Then compress both class and position embeddings to a vector with MLP. So I think D matches description precisely: encode class labels and corner points separately then merging with an MLP.

Let's check: Option A describes: "MagicDrive encode the class labels ... by the method similar to Li et al, where the pooled embeddings of the class names are considered as the label embeddings. And then uses an MLP to compress both the class and text embeddings into a single hidden vector." Actually the description uses the class embeddings from text encoding and also uses MLP for both parts? The description: "hb_i = Ebox(ci, bi) = MLPb(eb_c(i), eb_p(i))." So MLP compress both class and position embeddings. That is same action. But later the choice #C: "MagicDrive using the text encoder to encode the class label of bounding box, and then uses an MLP to compress both the class and text embeddings into a single hidden vector." But they don't mention position embeddings. So C seems wrong. Option B says Fourier embedding for 4 corner points only. Option A mis.
